item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera is helping her grandmother in the kitchen and garden. They discuss whether some changes happening around them are useful or harmful.

Which statements are correct?

1  Ripening of mangoes kept in a paper bag is desirable when the family wants to eat them soon.
2  Rusting of the iron gate is undesirable because it weakens the gate, even though rusting is a slow natural change.
3  The same change, such as the souring of milk, can be desirable when making curd but undesirable when the milk was meant for drinking.

statements.text: Ripening of mangoes kept in a paper bag is desirable when the family wants to eat them soon.
Rusting of the iron gate is undesirable because it weakens the gate, even though rusting is a slow natural change.
The same change, such as the souring of milk, can be desirable when making curd but undesirable when the milk was meant for drinking.
